name: claude-ai-journal
description: Set up and maintain a repo's AI operating system — a layered journal of docs + automation that makes every Claude Code session cheaper (less context re-derivation) and safer (design/security rules written down and enforced).

plugins.name: claude-ai-journal
plugins.description: Factorized subagents + commands that build and maintain {project}_journal/: architecture, service map, dev/security playbook, a target tracker, pending tasks, issues, suggestions, a review dashboard (journal.html), plus git/CI automation and a deterministic sync tool.
